attributes.board_name: Oregon Board of Psychology (Mental Health Regulatory Agency)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Learning activities contributing to professional competence: programs of recognized mental health organizations, accredited university/college courses, workplace education, organized study groups, home study, publications, lecturing, Board service, ethics committee meetings, reading (max 4 hours). The Board does not pre-approve providers
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE reporting for individuals licensed twelve months or less on their first renewal date.
rules.audit_note: Annual random audit; keep evidence of completion for two years after the reporting period. Fines for deficient hours ($250-$1000).

topics.who: Active and semi-active licensees: professional ethics and/or Oregon laws and regulations
Active and semi-active licensees; Oregon Pain Management Commission web module qualifies
Active and semi-active licensees: suicide risk assessment, treatment and management (since July 1, 2022)

rules.notes: Biennial renewal, last day of birth month. Home study plus study groups max 20 hours; teaching plus publications max 20 hours; reading max 4 hours. Active renewal fee $600.
rules.rule_quote: 858-040-0015 Basic Requirements (1) Licensees must earn at least 40 continuing education credits during the period between license renewals.
